title: Quality of Life the Danish Multiple Myeloma Patients
brief_summary: The aim of the project is to improve quality of life for multiple myeloma patients in the future.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Previously untreated or relapsed multiple myeloma patients AND
* Treatment demanding multiple myeloma disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to understand the Danish language or
* Psychic or mental illness that prevents the patient from answering the questions in the questionnaires.
